text:
luis-support: Customer reported a big p95 spike + 5xx on /v1/rerank yesterday during a bulk job. They saw gateway 504s and backend 502s. Said it started around 18:23 UTC and lasted ~12m. Sending full logs to the case.

maya-sre: noted. do we have an incident alert for rerank p95?

sre-bot: ALERT: rerank.gateway.p95 > 800ms for cluster rwd-us-west-2 — triggered at 2024-06-12T18:22:54Z :rotating_light:

samir-support: adding context from customer: their payload was ~300 candidates per request, 4k concurrent requests across 10 workers. they said they didn't change client-side rate limits.

alex-runtime: that candidate count is large — rerank pipeline has O(n log n) scoring and KV cache pressure. need to see if batching queue lengths spiked and if we hit circuit-breaker. can you paste gateway logs + backend traces?

luis-support: pasted snippets below (redacted):
```
2024-06-12T18:23:01Z gateway ERROR request_id=acme-1234 upstream=rerank-01 status=504 downstream=client proto=HTTP/1.1 path=/v1/rerank
2024-06-12T18:23:03Z rerank-01 ERROR request_id=acme-1234 model=lm-rank-v2 status=502 reason="worker-timeout" queue_ms=1204 batch_size=256
2024-06-12T18:23:05Z rerank-02 ERROR request_id=acme-2345 model=lm-rank-v2 status=502 reason="kv-cache-miss-thrash" alloc_ms=900
```

maya-sre: queue_ms > 1s and batch_size 256, that matches a severe backlog. any autoscale events?

ingrid-oncall: checked scale events: dedicated pool rwd-dedicated-3 scaled from 8->12 GPUs at 18:24 but scaling lag was ~45s. during that window pod restarts ~2 and GC spikes on a couple machines.

alex-runtime: GC + slow scaling + huge candidate lists = perfect storm. two mitigations: 1) suggest customer reduce candidates per request to <= 100 or use chunked rerank; 2) we can add a short-term gateway throttle rule for that tenant to cap concurrency/batch size.

samir-support: customer asked for repro steps so they can patch client. here's a minimal repro curl to demonstrate 504s (do not run on prod cluster):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"q","candidates": ["id1","id2", ... up to 300 ids] }'
```

luis-support: already suggested chunking to customer and offered a temporary Dedicated burst increase; they asked for root cause and durable fix.

maya-sre: long term: runtime should cap batch_size per-tenant when queue_ms > threshold, and gateway should surface per-request candidate count for better diagnostics. filing infra ticket to add metrics.

alex-runtime: also adding a quick debounce on autoscaler to avoid flapping on short GC spikes, and we'll instrument kv cache thrash counters. i'll open an RFC for soft-limits on candidate list size with graceful 413 response.

ingrid-oncall: for now i've applied a tenant-level concurrency cap of 50 and set a soft batch limit of 120 for the customer's tenant, will monitor.

samir-support: forwarding mitigation notes + repro to customer. asked them to retry with chunking and report results. they also want a timeline for our fixes.

luis-support: case updated: https://redwood.support/cases/CASE-7890 — customer replied they saw immediate reduction in errors after we applied cap. closing loop when RFC merged. :thumbsup:

maya-sre: keep me posted if any regression. good triage, team.

alex-runtime: i'll aim to have an RFC + instrumentation PR in the next week.

ingrid-oncall: leaving the tenant cap for 24h and will roll back if no more errors.

sre-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigation applied by ingrid-oncall at 2024-06-12T18:36:12Z — tenant concurrency cap=50, soft_batch_limit=120.
